newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -June JGBs rise seen capped below 124.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -June JGBs rise seen capped below 124.00.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: injection of 100 bln yen
*Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are likely to try for the upside on Friday after strong gains on Thursday afternoon. But June's rise may stop below 124.00.
*Given weaker-than-expected industrial output for April, downside room is seen limited. But technical long-liquidation before benchmark shift could push June down to 123.00.
